title: Remove Studio Bundle After Consolidation Into Sketchpad
description: Remove the semio/studio bundle directory entirely. The studio code has already been inlined into semio/sketchpad/index.tsx and semio/desktop/renderer.tsx. All source file imports from @semio/studio have been migrated. Remove the studio directory, clean up package-lock.json reference, and verify builds work.
summary: Removed the semio/studio bundle directory entirely. The code was already consolidated into semio/sketchpad/index.tsx (all interfaces, classes, factories: SyncDoc, CrdtDoc, PersistenceProviders, JsonFileKitStore, FolderKitStore, SessionKitStore, granular hooks) and semio/desktop/renderer.tsx (native Electron IPC callbacks passed via Desktop.kitFolder and Desktop.kitFile props). Cleaned @semio/studio entries from package-lock.json (node_modules symlink, dependency entries in desktop/play/sketchpad/vscode sections, and the studio package definition itself). No source files imported from @semio/studio. Desktop renderer.tsx compiles clean.
